independence_limits: The two effective reviewers and adjudicator ran as separate agents in one Codex task, not as independent human annotators.
Isolation claims about files not opened are reviewer self-reports; output coverage, assignment separation, reviewer IDs, and artifact hashes are machine-validated.
Reviewer confidence values were mechanically normalized into the rubric's high/medium/low enum without changing any relevance, safety, must-retrieve, issue-tag, or rationale decision.

invalidated_attempts.details: The initial reviewer A used project-wide text search to locate response enumeration and validator entry points. It self-reported the breach before submitting an effective review and was stopped and replaced.
invalidated_attempts.reason: The blind-review contract allowed only the rubric, one blind assignment, and its response template.
